note: ALL news sources of Wartabiye TV in ONE list. Section "somalia" is the website's REGIONAL feed, the page "Bariga Afrika": Somalia, Kenya, Ethiopia, Tanzania, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, Djibouti and Eritrea (owner's decision of 8 Nov 2026: Somalia news is collected again and BBC Somali is a source; the homepage mixes every section). sources.name: BBC Somali

permission.summary: BBC Somali's own public RSS feed (feeds.bbci.co.uk/somali/rss.xml). BBC content and photos are all rights reserved and Wartabiye TV has no syndication licence: only the feed's headline, link and publication time are used to discover a story. The article page is never scraped; Wartabiye TV writes its own Somali report from facts it verified, names BBC Somali as the source and links to the original. BBC text and photos are never copied, translated or republished, and a headline is never attributed to BBC unless it is in BBC's own feed.
